name: arculus
what: Modular production systems and autonomous mobile robots (arculees) replacing assembly lines.
homonym_note: Not Arculus (CompoSecure's crypto cold-storage card) nor the 2026 hydrogen-coatings Arculus (Dealroom item); both unrelated.

membership.basis: The firm's own portfolio text on visionaries.vc states the fund's participation.
membership.quote: Visionaries Club participated in December 2019 in a pre-emptive financing round alongside Atomico

entry.quote: proud today to announce our lead role in arculus's series A investment round

status.event: Acquired by Jungheinrich AG for an undisclosed amount

notes: Entry: the firm's own text dates its check to a 'pre-emptive financing round' in December 2019 alongside Atomico; Atomico's post (read via Wayback; sibling row dates it May 2020) calls that round the Series A it led. Round amount not found. PARTNER ANGEL: Atomico calls Robert Lacher a 'respected seed round investor & board member', i.e. Lacher personally invested in the earlier seed; that is a personal angel check, not a fund position, so the seed is not the fund's entry. The Dec 2019 date also predates the first closings of Seed Fund I / Growth Fund I (2020), so the vehicle is unknown. Exit: Jungheinrich acquired Munich-based arculus GmbH for an undisclosed amount (The Robot Report 2021-11-10; the firm's text says October 2021). Founded 2016 (The Robot Report). Agrees with the Atomico sibling row (acquired, Munich, Industrial & Robotics, Series A).
